### Mötley Crüe to Play The Colosseum at Caesars Palace March 19-April 3, 2027


10/19/2026


[Download this Press Release (opens in new window) PDF 530 KB](https://s202.q4cdn.com/508919455/files/doc_news/Mtley-Cre-to-Play-The-Colosseum-at-Caesars-Palace-March-19-April-3-2027-2026.pdf)


**MÖTLEY CRÜE AT THE COLOSSEUM AT CAESARS PALACE,** **CARNIVAL OF SINS IN SIN CITY**


**L** **IMITED RUN OF SHOWS AT THE COLOSSEUM AT CAESARS PALACE** **MARCH 19 – APRIL 3, 2027**


***TICKETS GO ON SALE FRIDAY, OCT. 23 AT 10 A.M. PT***


***A PORTION OF TICKET PROCEEDS WILL BENEFIT*** ***NEVADA PARTNERSHIP FOR HOMELESS YOUTH***


**MÖTLEY CRÜE CELEBRATES 45 YEARS WITH THE** ***TOO FAST FOR LOVE* DEFINITIVE DELUXE LIMITED EDITION** **PRE-SAVE / PRE-ADD / PRE-ORDER**[HERE](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcrue.lnk.to%2FTooFastForLove45&esheet=54624358&newsitemid=20261019422797&lan=en-US&anchor=HERE&index=1&md5=84ae32b50956fb2d0571691b1e28cb3c)


LAS VEGAS--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


**MÖTLEY CRÜE** **RETURNS TO THE LAS VEGAS STRIP**


**Mötley Crüe** is heading back to Las Vegas next spring with ***Mötley Crüe*** ***At The Colosseum At Caesars Palace, Carnival Of Sins in Sin City*** , an exclusive limited run of eight shows at **The Colosseum at Caesars Palace,** running **March 19 through April 3, 2027.**


The legendary band that pioneered the Las Vegas rock residency over a decade ago is excited to return to the city following their three previous sold-out residencies: *Mötley Crüe Takes On Sin City* (2012), *Evening In Hell* (2013) and *The Las Vegas Residency* (2025).


With its fourth Las Vegas residency, Mötley Crüe brings the hugely successful *Carnival of Sins* tour to **The Colosseum at Caesars Palace,** one of Las Vegas’ most iconic venues. Featuring stunning visuals and a fan-voted setlist of iconic hits—including songs returning to the stage for the first time in decades—this special limited run of performances promises to highlight the legendary bravado, spectacle, and high-voltage energy only Mötley Crüe can deliver.


An exclusive pre-sale for members of Mötley Crüe's **S.I.N. Club** will begin tomorrow, **Tuesday, Oct. 20 at 10 a.m. PT.** Join the S.I.N. Club for free[HERE](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.crueseum.com%2F&esheet=54624358&newsitemid=20261019422797&lan=en-US&anchor=HERE&index=2&md5=9fd0224dc925f444a9e2c63428710f49) .


Citi is the official card of Mötley Crüe’s ** residency at The Colosseum at Caesars Palace. Citi card members will have access to pre-sale tickets beginning tomorrow, **Tuesday, Oct. 20 at 10 a.m. PT until Thursday, Oct. 22 at 10 p.m. PT** through the Citi Entertainment program. For complete pre-sale details, visit[www.citientertainment.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.citientertainment.com%2F&esheet=54624358&newsitemid=20261019422797&lan=en-US&anchor=www.citientertainment.com&index=3&md5=711012b21eb3ba1e78d8f19bc467265a) .


Caesars Rewards members, Caesars Entertainment’s loyalty program, as well as Live Nation customers, will have access to a presale beginning **Thursday, Oct. 22 at 10 a.m. PT.**


Tickets for the following eight shows go on sale to the public **Friday, Oct. 23 at 10 a.m. PT** at[ticketmaster.com/MotleyCrueVegas](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.ticketmaster.com%2FMotleyCrueVegas&esheet=54624358&newsitemid=20261019422797&lan=en-US&anchor=ticketmaster.com%2FMotleyCrueVegas&index=4&md5=2fb35a4b846f62b22d1fa4c4aae5cb55) . All shows begin at 8 p.m.


***MÖTLEY CRÜE AT THE COLOSSEUM AT CAESARS PALACE*** ***CARNIVAL OF SINS IN SIN CITY*** **2027 SHOW DATES:**


**MARCH 2027:** 19, 20, 24, 26, 27, 31
**APRIL 2027:** 2, 3


Mötley Crüe also announced today that a portion of the proceeds from ticket sales of *Mötley Crüe* *At The Colosseum At Caesars Palace, Carnival Of Sins in Sin City,* will be donated to[Nevada Partnership for Homeless Youth](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fnphy.org%2F&esheet=54624358&newsitemid=20261019422797&lan=en-US&anchor=Nevada+Partnership+for+Homeless+Youth&index=5&md5=ea24de3305261de0f303a6863b69edb8)[,](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fnphy.org%2F&esheet=54624358&newsitemid=20261019422797&lan=en-US&anchor=%2C&index=6&md5=24ed9aa24605a5658ad0dbc99ec2093d) a Las Vegas-based organization that provides the thousands of young people experiencing homelessness in Southern Nevada with wraparound support to help youth move into stable housing, grow and flourish.


On October 30, Mötley Crüe **** will release a special 45th Anniversary Limited Edition Box Set of their legendary debut album ***Too Fast For Love*** , via BMG. One of the best debut albums of all time, *Too Fast For Love* was the first great Los Angeles hard rock album of the ‘80s, helping kick open the doors for that decade’s fertile Hollywood rock scene, as well as the signing frenzy and imitators that followed. The centerpiece of the 45th anniversary celebration is a limited edition deluxe box set that includes the 1981 Leathür Records version (which sells for thousands of dollars when one becomes available), the 1982 Elektra Records version, live recordings from the legendary Perkins Palace shows in 1982 (previewing tracks from 1983’s epic *Shout At The Devil),* never-before-released 5-track 1LP featuring demos from the band's first-ever studio sessions from March 1981, replica demo cassette, replica 7” single, 100-page photo book, replica poster and more. **Pre-Order Limited Edition Sets**[HERE](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcrue.lnk.to%2FTooFastForLove45&esheet=54624358&newsitemid=20261019422797&lan=en-US&anchor=HERE&index=7&md5=ab3ba040f59d6ed1a5d705dd87ea5759)


An ultra-limited, hand-numbered version with additional elements, available exclusively at the[Crüeseum](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.crueseum.com%2F&esheet=54624358&newsitemid=20261019422797&lan=en-US&anchor=Cr%26uuml%3Beseum&index=8&md5=d57b2c60b8c4f7d074179eb364b34959) , has already SOLD OUT. Standard Editions of *Too Fast For Love* will be available on CD and LP, alongside physical retail-exclusive editions at Walmart (CD and LP), Independent Retail (LP), Amazon (LP) and Revolver (LP). For the first time, *Too Fast For Love – Leathür Records Version* will be available on streaming services.


Listen to the newly remastered “Take Me To The Top (Leathür Records Version)” and Pre-Add/Pre-Save/Pre-Order[HERE](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcrue.lnk.to%2FTooFastForLove45&esheet=54624358&newsitemid=20261019422797&lan=en-US&anchor=HERE&index=9&md5=ce9a25814625c825297670f5fd1daa63)


***Download photo***[HERE](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.dropbox.com%2Fscl%2Ffi%2Fncmxc7zmicjui6ah1z8qe%2FRH-2026-09-19-0017.jpg%3Frlkey%3Dqstxmd9yuipm1a34nyj2igmwl%26st%3D3mwtqppi%26dl%3D0&esheet=54624358&newsitemid=20261019422797&lan=en-US&anchor=HERE&index=10&md5=230a312bf99412945d2a701a51ff3705) ****** ***Photo Credit: Ross Halfin***


**About Mötley Crüe:** Hailing from Los Angeles, CA, Mötley Crüe has commandeered the rock pantheon for 40+ years. The band has sold over 100 million albums worldwide and has amassed 7 USA Platinum and Multi-Platinum albums, 8 Gold, Platinum or Multi-Platinum singles, 22 Top 40 mainstream rock hits, 6 Top 20 pop singles, 3 GRAMMY® nominations, 5 New York Times Best Selling books, a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame, and a hit Netflix movie. The quartet has amassed nearly 10 billion streams and has over 9.5 million followers on social media. Known for their iconic live performances, Mötley Crüe has sold out countless tours around the world in front of millions of fans and pioneered the Las Vegas rock residency with a sold-out run in 2012. Hit songs, like “Kickstart My Heart” and “Home Sweet Home,” are frequently licensed by major brands such as NASCAR, Dodge, Coldwell Banker, Carl's Jr., and KIA, and their music can be heard on hit TV shows like *Stranger* *Things* and *Cobra Kai* , among others. The band’s biography, *The Dirt: Confessions of the World’s Most Notorious* *Rock Band* , became a New York Times Best Seller in 2001 and has sold over 1 million copies worldwide. Members of the band have authored 5 additional New York Times Best Selling books since. In 2019, Netflix premiered *The* *Dirt* , a biopic based on the bestselling book. Mötley Crüe remains a huge global draw 45 years into their career, wrapping up a two-year stadium world tour in late 2023. In 2024, the band ushered in a brand-new era, signing to Big Machine Records and releasing the single “Dogs of War.” 2025 saw Mötley Crüe return to the Las Vegas Strip for the band’s third Sin City residency - the first one since 2013 - with ten nights at Dolby Live at Park MGM. Mötley Crüe is celebrating their 45th anniversary in 2026, following a massive North American tour from July through September.

Both Caesars Palace and Nobu Hotel Caesars Palace have also received AAA Four Diamond designations. The 85-acre resort offers diverse dining options from the award-winning Bacchanal Buffet to celebrity chef-branded restaurants, including Gordon Ramsay HELL’S KITCHEN, Pronto by Giada, Amalfi by Bobby Flay, Vanderpump Cocktail Garden by restaurateur and television star Lisa Vanderpump, one of Nobu Matsuhisa’s largest Nobu restaurants, Restaurant Guy Savoy, award-winning pastry chef Dominique Ansel’s first Las Vegas bakery, Stanton Social Italian – a dining concept in partnership with Tao Group Hospitality, legendary New York Steak House Peter Luger and Brasserie B Parisian Steakhouse by Bobby Flay. The Celebrity Food Hall features Guy Fieri’s Chicken Guy!, Bobby’s Burgers by Bobby Flay, Tortazo by Rick Bayless, Buddy V’s Pizzeria and Mokbar by Esther Choi. For the best in cocktails, destination lounges include Montecristo Cigar Bar, VISTA Cocktail Lounge, Stadia Bar and Caspian’s – a cocktail and caviar bar with Clique Hospitality. The resort also features nearly 130,000 square feet of casino space, the Caesars Race & Sportsbook at Caesars Palace with a 143-foot HD LED screen and state-of-the-art sound, a five-acre Garden of the Gods Pool Oasis, the luxurious Qua Baths & Spa, Hairdreams by Michael Boychuck, five wedding chapels and gardens, the 75,000-square-foot OMNIA Nightclub and OMNIA Dayclub & Skybar on Las Vegas Boulevard. The Colosseum currently spotlights world-class entertainers, including LISA, Mötley Crüe, Sting, Tim McGraw and Rod Stewart. **About NPHY** NPHY is the most comprehensive service provider for youth experiencing homelessness in Southern Nevada. Since 2001, NPHY’s best-practice programs have helped thousands of homeless youth graduate from high school, enroll in college, embark on careers, find their passions, build supportive social networks, transition to safe and stable housing, and realize brighter futures. Strengthening and complementing its high-quality direct services, NPHY is dedicated to advocating with and for Nevada’s most vulnerable youth and serves as a leader in efforts to eliminate homelessness throughout the state. In 2017, NPHY founded The Movement to End Youth Homelessness, which hosts the annual Nevada Youth Homelessness Summit and drives NPHY's legislative work, community coordination, system-level efforts and our mission to end youth homelessness for each youth we encounter and our community as a whole. For more information or to support our life-changing work for youth experiencing homelessness, please visit[www.nphy.org](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.nphy.org%2F&esheet=54624358&newsitemid=20261019422797&lan=en-US&anchor=www.nphy.org&index=29&md5=b534c8278f314cd4c39dffea59a5afcf) .
